items.description: Horace William Madden was an Australian Army soldier who was posthumously awarded the George Cross, the highest award for extraordinary acts of gallantry away from the field of battle that could be awarded to a member of the Australian armed forces at the time. items.title: Abdul El-Sayed
items.description: Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed is an American epidemiologist and politician who is the United States senator-elect from the state of Michigan. Upon taking office, El-Sayed will be the first Muslim senator in U.S. history.

items.title: Ramayana: Part 1
items.description: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the epic poem Ramayana by Valmiki, which chronicles the life and trials of Prince Rama. It is the first of a two-part film. items.title: Russell Brand
items.description: Russell Edward Brand is an English comedian, actor, and media personality. items.title: James Talarico
items.description: James Dell Talarico is an American politician and educator who is the United States senator-elect from Texas. A member of the Democratic Party, he has served since 2018 as a member of the Texas House of Representatives.

items.title: 2026 United States elections
items.description: Elections in the United States were held on November 3, 2026. items.title: Jon Ossoff
items.description: Thomas Jonathan Ossoff is an American politician who has served as the senior United States senator from Georgia since 2021. He is the youngest incumbent U.S. senator, and a member of the Democratic Party.
